4381-4694-7306-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-7306-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

339-677-7060-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2281-4681-8095.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Karmic Guide
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide dies, Saffi triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

710-2843-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-4779-5131-7692--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4779-5131-7692--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Shuri.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

3967-4082-4640--201.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2511-2738-4871-6248.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Phenomenon Investigators, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

147-3125-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
147-3125-4050.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Dualcaster Mage and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

6410-7500.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least six Goblins.
6410-7500.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat.

650-891-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

240-2438-4885-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

1734-4050-5987.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Repeat from step 3.

397-5670-7173.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-5670-7173.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3375-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

81-1978-5056.description:
Cause Kami of Whispered Hopes to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat from step 2.

5220-5686-6538-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

2438-2558-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Repeat.

783-1825-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Jungle Basin and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
783-1825-6760.description:
Activate Jungle Basin and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Jungle Basin and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

565-1484-1858--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1484-1858--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

654-2292-5222-6644.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

359-372-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-5913.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

224-940-6133.notablePrerequisites:
Avenging Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Arcane Teachings attached to Avenging Druid.
224-940-6133.description:
Activate Avenging Druid by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Avenging Druid triggers, causing you to reveal a land card from your library and put it onto the battlefield, and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Avenging Druid.
Repeat until no lands remain in your library and/or your library is empty.

1636-5698.notablePrerequisites: Ulamog's Dreadshire does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature token.
When the Eldrazi enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

887-1360-4490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
887-1360-4490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing that much damage to an opponent.
Virtue of Courage triggers, causing you to exile that many cards from the top of your library.
Laelia's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1306-2073-4139.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Mana Crypt, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2173-4336-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

876-2034-2703-2713.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Propagator.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator, adding {2}.
Repeat.

25-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Torsten, adding {1}.
Torsten dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Torsten trigger, creating seven 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Soldiers, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Torsten from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Torsten enters the battlefield, allowing you to search the top seven cards of your library and put any number of creature and/or land cards from them into your hand.
Repeat.

1193-3277-4095.notablePrerequisites: There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
1193-3277-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna targeting anything but Chronarch, holding priority, and then cast Radiate targeting Mythos of Illuna.
When Radiate resolves you will have Mythos copies targeting every targetable permanent (except what the original Mythos card is targeting).
When each of the copies resolve, target Radiate in your graveyard with the new Chronarch token's ability and return Radiate to your hand.
Before the original Mythos of Illuna card resolves, cast Radiate again targeting Mythos by spending mana from the tokens you just created.
Repeat this process, effectively doubling the number of copies created, allowing you to return Radiate and another card with two Chronarch triggers.
Repeat.

1304-2232-4667-4882.notablePrerequisites: Nature's Chosen attached to Elvish Aberration.
1304-2232-4667-4882.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Nature's Chosen by paying {0}, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Cast Frog Tongue by paying {G}, attaching it to Elvish Aberration.
Frog Tongue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Frog Tongue trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Nature's Chosen from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Nature's Chosen by paying {G}, attaching it to Elvish Aberration.
Nature's Chosen enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Frog Tongue from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

306-2493-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Cache Raiders triggers, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
